issues.legal_issue: Receipt of an arbitral award by a person authorized to represent family members constitutes receipt by those members for purposes of challenging the award.
material_facts: The family members signed an agreement appointing arbitrators and providing that each member would receive a copy of the award.
An interim agreement was signed by the family representative for himself and as power of attorney holder for his wife, sons and daughter-in-law.
The representative acknowledged receipt of the signed award for himself and on behalf of his family members.
The representative was the head of the family, participated in and controlled the proceedings, and the family members had authorized him to act for them.
The family members later challenged the award together in a single application.
issues.conclusion: Receipt of the award by the representative constituted service on the other family members, and they could not rely on its non-delivery to them individually to claim non-compliance with the delivery requirement.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 31(5) and 34(3) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 require delivery of a signed award to the party and make receipt relevant to commencement of limitation. Tecco Trichy Engineers and Contractors v. Union of India and State of Maharashtra v. Ark Builders Pvt. Ltd. establish that valid delivery and receipt are required. On these facts, an authorized representative’s receipt was attributable to the family members he represented.

predicates.family_arbitration_challenge: The proceeding challenges an arbitral award on behalf of members of a family.
predicates.family_members_authorized_representative: The family members authorized one representative to act for them in the arbitration or in receiving its award.
predicates.representative_received_signed_award: The representative received and acknowledged the signed arbitral award for himself and the family members.

issues.definition: When a family challenges an arbitral award and its authorized representative receives the signed award for the family, service is effective for the family members.

issues.legal_issue: A challenge to an arbitral award is time barred when the applicant, personally or through an authorized representative, received the award and filed the challenge after the permitted time.
material_facts: The representative received the award for himself and on behalf of the family members in 1996.
The representative acted on the award soon after receiving it and later relied on it in communications and legal proceedings.
The family members filed their application challenging the award in 2005, asserting that they learned of it only when served with an execution notice.
The representative’s receipt was attributable to the family members, and the challenge was filed beyond the applicable limitation period.
issues.conclusion: The application to set aside the award was barred by limitation, and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 34(3) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 starts limitation when the applicant receives the award, read with the signed-copy delivery requirement in Section 31(5). Tecco Trichy Engineers and Contractors v. Union of India and State of Maharashtra v. Ark Builders Pvt. Ltd. apply that rule. The proviso to Section 34(3) allows an extension for sufficient cause only within the further period specified there; its words “but not thereafter” are mandatory, as stated in State of Arunachal Pradesh v. Damini Construction Co.

predicates.arbitral_award_challenge: The proceeding is an application to set aside an arbitral award.
predicates.award_received_by_applicant_or_authorize: The applicant or a person authorized to represent the applicant received the award.
predicates.application_filed_after_permitted_time: The application was filed after the time permitted for challenging the award had expired.

issues.definition: An application to set aside an arbitral award is time barred when the applicant or an authorized representative received the award and the application was filed after the permitted time.
